=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1311 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The prior cycle job log is fetched with `gh_retry gh api` without `--allow-escape-sequences`, although the repository's existing log-fetching code documents that GitHub Actions logs contain ANSI escapes and that `gh` rejects them without this flag (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1713-1720`).
  WHY: When a prior cycle log contains ANSI escapes, the fetch fails and this code logs `guard_unavailable`, so the `cycle_gate_unavailable` streak is not reported (source severity MAJOR).
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1454-1594 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: release_blocker_check_cycle_stale (lines 1454-1482) can run after release_blocker_main_ahead=true (line 1563) but before release_blocker_baseline_at is assigned (line 1593). This happens on a guard_unavailable skip in require_stable_branch_ancestor (line 1568 / 568, lookup=branch) or when the marker search fails (line 1588). In that case rb_clock falls back to the oldest unreleased commit date alone (lines 1464-1467).
  WHY: guard_unavailable is not in the excluded list (disabled|insufficient_docs|cycle_in_flight|another_run_active), so a transient search or branch-lookup failure sends a false cycle_stale release_blocker report with an inflated age, which opens or bumps an ai:workflow-heal issue for a cycle that is not stale. This contradicts the documented "later of baseline-marker time and oldest unreleased commit date" rule (source severity MAJOR).
- changelog.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-cycle-reporters.md:File name | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The fragment file name does not follow the required naming convention <issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md.
  WHY: This causes the changelog assembler tests to fail (test_changelog_fragment_contract.py::test_assembler_and_fragment_directory_exist), breaking the release gate (source severity BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 separately stated that the test_changelog_fragment_contract.py failures cannot be traced to this diff.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-cycle-reporters.md:File name | severity=critical | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The fragment file name does not follow the required naming convention <issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md.
  WHY: This causes the agents file assembler tests to fail, breaking the documentation assembly contract (source severity BLOCKER).
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:Multiple tests in tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The newly added dispatch capability (POST repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/dispatches) causes the GH API write guard tests to fail.
  WHY: The tests verify that only permitted workflows can dispatch, and the new reporter path is not explicitly configured in the guard allowlist (source severity BLOCKER).
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:259, 1408-1431 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The threshold validation regex `^[0-9]{1,10}$` accepts leading-zero values (e.g. `0086400`). The raw value is passed to `jq --argjson cap` (line 1410), which rejects JSON numbers with leading zeros; the error is masked by `2>/dev/null || true` (line 1430), and line 1431 returns silently.
  WHY: A leading-zero `RELEASE_BLOCKER_UNTRUSTED_HOLD_SECS` silently disables `cycle_held_untrusted_marker` detection with no log line and no threshold warning, contrary to the warn-and-fall-back contract at 243-244. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1307-1319 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In release_blocker_check_skip_streak, two non-report exits return silently with no log line. Lines 1307-1310 cover no `cycle` job or a non-numeric rb_job_id; lines 1317-1319 cover an empty rb_matched or no matching `PROMOTE_CYCLE_SKIPPED reason=` line. Every sibling exit logs RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED (lines 1297, 1303, 1312, 1325).
  WHY: Operators cannot tell "streak legitimately broken" apart from "check failed or matched nothing" (e.g. renamed cycle job, changed log format, truncated log) in the cycle job log. This affects diagnosis only; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1408-1431 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In release_blocker_check_untrusted_hold, `rb_found="$(... jq -r ... 2>/dev/null || true)"` followed by `[ -n "${rb_found}" ] || return 0` masks any jq parse failure (unexpected GraphQL shape, a threshold jq rejects, malformed trusted-associations JSON).
  WHY: Every other failed read logs `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=guard_unavailable blocker=cycle_held_untrusted_marker lookup=untrusted_comments`, but a jq-side failure returns with no log line, so "no held issue past the threshold" cannot be told apart from "detection failed" (NIT).
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1475-1481 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In release_blocker_check_untrusted_hold, the jq filter execution is hidden by || true.
  WHY: If the GraphQL response shape is unexpected or the filter fails, the reporter returns silently, masking a detection failure. This is likely the same root cause as the 1408-1431 entry, but the line ranges do not overlap, so the entries are not merged (NIT).
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:1153-1157 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_graphql_calls` was redefined to count only GraphQL queries containing `LABELED_EVENT`. As a result, `test_hold_release_disabled_keeps_todays_skip_and_makes_no_graphql_call` (1159) and `test_hold_without_latch_label_makes_no_graphql_call` (1170) pass trivially even though the untrusted-hold reporter makes a comments GraphQL read on every `cycle_in_flight` skip.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the assertions no longer verify what the test names state, weakening the contract for the cycle-in-flight path. All reviewers rated it NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:release_blocker_check_cycle_stale (lines 1454-1482), together with the main-flow ordering at lines 1563 (release_blocker_main_ahead=true), 1568 (require_stable_branch_ancestor), 1583-1594 (guard 4: last_cycle_baseline_sha with_time, the skip_cycle guard_unavailable "search=..." at 1588, then release_blocker_baseline_at assigned at 1593) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On a guard_unavailable skip between line 1563 and line 1593 (in require_stable_branch_ancestor, line 568 lookup=branch, or a failed marker search at line 1588), release_blocker_on_skip marks the skip relevant. rb_marker_t is then empty, so rb_clock falls back to the oldest unreleased commit date alone (lines 1464-1467).
  WHY: A transient failure while daily cycles still run sends a cycle_stale report with an inflated age and opens or bumps an ai:workflow-heal issue. This contradicts the documented clock rule and the guard_unavailable no-report handling elsewhere. Suggested fix: a release_blocker_baseline_read=true flag set after the rc check at line 1589, or add guard_unavailable to the excluded lists.
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:_graphql_calls helper (diff hunk at old line 1125 / new line ~1153) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The helper counts only LABELED_EVENT queries, so test_hold_release_disabled_keeps_todays_skip_and_makes_no_graphql_call no longer matches its name: the run makes a GraphQL comments read from release_blocker_check_untrusted_hold at the line 990 skip.
  WHY: This is a test-clarity regression, not a behavior bug.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:release_blocker_check_skip_streak, lines 1307-1310 and lines 1317-1319 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Two exits return with no log line, while sibling exits log RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED (lines 1297, 1303, 1312, 1325).
  WHY: A correctly broken streak cannot be told apart from a detector that matched nothing. This affects diagnosis only.
- HARDENING (3 related items): release_blocker_check_untrusted_hold jq `|| true` swallows failures; capture the exit status and log `lookup=untrusted_parse`, est. 4 lines. The threshold validation loop accepts leading zeros (e.g. "0086400") that break `--argjson cap`; normalise via `printf -v ... '%d' "$((10#...))"`, est. 1 line. A release_blocker_check_cycle_stale guard `[ "${release_blocker_baseline_read:-false}" = "true" ] || return 0`, est. 2 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- NOTE: The test_changelog_fragment_contract.py pre-push failures cannot be traced to this diff. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (custom_instructions_too_large) shows no defect in the diff. TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
